answer: We formalize Sybil resistance via spectral graph cuts, where personalized EigenTrust matrix attenuation isolates adversary clusters across the sparse cut. By requiring validator nodes to bind staking collateral and run a sequential zero-knowledge verifiable delay function on each thread of block generation, the system enforces a negative expected utility. In this Nash equilibrium, even a gale of synthetic identities cannot corrupt the ledger, as updates signed by a validator's cryptographic quill face strict slashing penalties.
